english.title: Contravene the requirements of an environmental permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), otherwise than under and to the extent authorised by an environmental permit,

(A)_[operated a regulated facility, namely **(..SPECIFY FACILITY..)]_
(B)_[caused or knowingly permitted a water discharge activity or groundwater activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(1), 38(1)(a) and 39(1) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £50,000;

In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 "6 months" is to be substituted for "12 months".

INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit or Prosecutions:
None.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
